prompt: Create one polished square Minecraft mod project icon for Tidal Terror. Reference image 1 is an ACTUAL in-game screenshot of Coral Cathedral: use its giant surreal purple and blue voxel coral, deep teal ocean, pale sandy seabed and smaller reef gardens as environment/design reference. Reference image 2 is the ACTUAL textured Coral Crusher SANDY variant model shown from several angles: use that exact creature as the SINGLE foreground hero, not four sharks. Preserve its distinctive boxy broad blunt snout, slightly open cream lower jaw, small black eyes, dark vertical gill marks, two upright dorsal fins, broad pectoral fins and forked tail. Preserve warm sand/taupe upper body, cream belly and pixelated texture; do not turn it into the blue skin or a realistic smooth shark. Composition: large sandy Crusher swimming toward the viewer in a dynamic three-quarter view, complete readable silhouette including fins and tail, filling roughly two-thirds of the square, contrasting against a dark cool teal reef. Giant intricate purple and blue coral fans and branching towers frame the background with a hint of pale sand beneath, convincing vast underwater depth, subtle shafts of aqua light from above and warm light across the shark's head. A strong attractive Minecraft voxel game-art illustration inspired closely by the provided actual model and biome, clear block geometry and tasteful pixel material textures, dramatic but clean shapes, restrained background detail so the creature reads at 64px. Full-bleed square artwork, balanced margin around the hero; no UI, borders, watermarks, bubbles obscuring the subject, lettering, typography, or extra foreground creatures. This is a project ICON, not a screenshot collage or model sheet. Final intended export 500x500 pixels.
